name: mythfall-portrait-ellis_crow
instruction: A polished hand-painted portrait for a grounded medieval fantasy roleplaying game, bust portrait with face clearly readable at small sizes, softly textured gouache and oil paint, subtle expressive eyes, warm candlelight and cool misty shadows, muted moss green, brown and aged gold. Square composition, centered head and shoulders, plain dark desaturated green backdrop, no frame, no writing, no UI, no extra people. Ellis Crow, a nervous slender adult male scholar, tousled dark hair, cracked round spectacles, ink-stained fingers holding a weathered notebook, worn green scholar's clothes.
